covers: Gap 109. Contract freeze for POST /_cpcp/rpc dual signalling. RpcController remains HTTP 200 at all four render sites until dual-v1 is implemented behind a flag. Do not flatten Envelope.fail. Do not copy vault verbatim.
rollout: per-method opt-in, seam by seam, not a controller-wide flip
stock_rpc_controller: must remain status: :ok at all four render sites while implemented is false

vault.because: vault is REST stand-in, flat {ok,reason,because}, already non-200. BACK is nested Envelope.fail and still all-200. Row 4 migrates vault; this profile maps BACK.

envelope.shape: nested rails-cpcp Envelope.fail: {ok:false, error:{reason, because}}. Do not flatten this turn.
envelope.failure_layer_wire: on error, next to reason/because, required under dual-v1 for ok:false
envelope.failure_layer_owner_sentinel: owner is a mapping-table value only, never a wire value. dual-v1 must not emit it. Methods that produce an owner row stay on legacy-all-200 until the owner fills the layer.

grounding_vs_422.decision: grounding is 200; 422 is a different event
grounding_vs_422.because: Grounding in this tree is the method completing: cpcp_adapter raises KnownRefusal grounding_refused after evaluating the domain payload against SHACL. Manus's rule keeps 200 for an intentionally completed RPC whose result is a domain decision. 422 would reclassify that completed evaluation as HTTP-unprocessable content and make failure_layer vestigial for the common refusal. One SHACL event, one status.
grounding_vs_422.four22_is: well-formed JSON-RPC whose request document (params as a CPCP instruction shape) fails SHACL before Dispatcher invokes the method. No live producer on BACK today (RequestBody only distinguishes empty_body / unparseable_json, which are 400). A later request-shape gate may emit 422. It MUST NOT relabel grounding_refused.

retry.rule: 503 is not a general retry signal
retry.retry_after: only when the recovery window is known AND replay is safe (idempotency key present, or the method is idempotent)
retry.because: this tree has already duplicated a blob by retrying

out_of_scope: GET /_cpcp/up and GET /_cpcp/cid.json stay 200; they are not RPC method results
Python urlopen body-on-4xx is gap 104; fix clients before or with enabling dual-v1, not this freeze

classes.when: payload failed SHACL at admission after the method evaluated it
authorization evidence denied (P6). HTTP 200 as a completed method result; whether the LAYER is domain or http_auth is an owner call.
pre-RPC parse: empty body or not a JSON object
missing or invalid caller credentials at the HTTP layer. No live BACK producer today (RpcController skips CSRF; auth is in projected handlers).
authenticated caller not permitted at the HTTP/resource layer. Distinct from authorization_denied (admission). No live BACK producer today.
genuine absence of the HTTP target. Never a generic domain refusal. unknown RPC method is not this class.
well-formed JSON-RPC whose CPCP request document fails SHACL before dispatch. Not grounding.
GRAPH upstream returned an invalid response

callers.note: Net::HTTP#request does not raise on 4xx; body is kept. urllib.request.urlopen raises HTTPError and a with-block never reads e.read(). BackCpcpClient re-wraps {ok, error} and would drop a top-level failure_layer -- that is why the field sits on error. Gap 104 still owns the Python fix. Do not change these files in the freeze.

release_sequence: 1 freeze (this turn): mapping table, failure_layer design, grounding=200, 503 retry rule, per-method opt-in
2 client readiness: Python urlopen wrappers read HTTPError body (gap 104); Ruby tests assert non-2xx still parse
3 server mapper behind CPCP_HTTP_STATUS_PROFILE=dual-v1; Cache-Control: no-store on refusals; WWW-Authenticate on 401
5 expand writes; do not default the flag on until gap 104 is closed
